accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Bhargava Committee — Legal safeguards for Mulki employment
Wanchoo Committee — Assessment of Telangana surplus funds
Srikrishna Committee — Consultation on the Telangana/united Andhra Pradesh question
Sivaramakrishnan Committee — Investigation of literacy disparities
accepted.x: The Srikrishna Committee, headed by Justice B.N. Srikrishna, was appointed in 2010 to consult on the Telangana or united Andhra Pradesh question. The Bhargava Committee dealt with surplus funds, the Wanchoo Committee with Mulki safeguards, and the Sivaramakrishnan Committee with locating the new capital.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure committee–mandate pair and eliminate swapped mandates.
accepted.sec: Committees on regional imbalance → mandate

accepted.s: The Bhargava Committee, constituted in 1969, was primarily concerned with which of the following?
o: Consulting stakeholders on the united Andhra Pradesh question
Assessing Telangana surplus funds diverted to other regions
Providing legal safeguards for Mulki employment
Locating the new capital of Andhra Pradesh
accepted.x: The Bhargava Committee of 1969 assessed the Telangana surplus funds that had allegedly been diverted to other regions.
accepted.tq: Direct committee–mandate recall.
accepted.sec: Committees on regional imbalance → mandate

accepted.s:
With reference to the Wanchoo Committee, consider the following statements:
1. It was constituted in 1969.
2. It examined legal and constitutional methods for retaining Mulki employment safeguards.
3. It was headed by Justice B.N. Srikrishna.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because Justice B.N. Srikrishna headed the Srikrishna Committee constituted in 2010.
accepted.tq: Separate the committee’s year and mandate from the swapped chairperson trap.
accepted.sec: Committees on regional imbalance → mandate

accepted.s: The report of the Srikrishna Committee, constituted in 2010, was submitted in December 2010 and contained how many options?
accepted.x: The Srikrishna Committee submitted its report in December 2010 and presented six options on the Telangana/united Andhra Pradesh question.
accepted.tq: Numerical recall of the committee’s report and options.
accepted.sec: Committees on regional imbalance → mandate

accepted.s: Which committee was constituted under the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 as an expert committee for locating the new capital of Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: The Sivaramakrishnan Committee, headed by K.C. Sivaramakrishnan, was the expert committee under the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014, for locating the new capital of Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Who would perform this specific statutory task?
accepted.sec: Committees on regional imbalance → mandate

accepted.s:
The 8-Point Formula of 1969 provided for which of the following institutional arrangements?
1. A high-level committee under a judge
2. A special committee on Telangana surpluses
3. An expert committee for locating the new capital of Andhra Pradesh
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The 8-Point Formula of 1969 itself set up a high-level committee under a judge and a special committee on Telangana surpluses. The capital-location committee was constituted much later under the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014.
accepted.tq: Use chronology to reject the later capital-location committee.
accepted.sec: Committees on regional imbalance → mandate

accepted.s: The appointed day under the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 was:
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 took effect on the appointed day, 2 June 2014.
accepted.tq: Direct date recall with close-date distractors.
accepted.sec: AP Reorganisation Act 2014 - backward districts package, special category status

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the capital arrangement under the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014:
1. Hyderabad was designated as the common capital of Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
2. The common-capital arrangement could continue for up to ten years.
3. The arrangement was intended to continue permanently.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because Hyderabad was to serve as the common capital for up to ten years, not permanently.
accepted.tq: Watch the time-limit trap in a statutory arrangement.
accepted.sec: AP Reorganisation Act 2014 - backward districts package, special category status

accepted.s: Which sections of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 provide, respectively, for a special development package for backward areas and tax incentives?
accepted.x: Sections 46(2)-(3) provide for a special development package for backward areas, while Section 94 provides tax incentives.
accepted.tq: Match the statutory provision with its subject before checking the code.
accepted.sec: AP Reorganisation Act 2014 - backward districts package, special category status

accepted.s: The backward districts package for Andhra Pradesh covered:
o: Six districts—three in Rayalaseema and three in Coastal Andhra—with ₹100 crore per district per year
Seven districts—four in Rayalaseema and three in North Andhra—with ₹50 crore per district per year
Seven districts—three in Rayalaseema and four in North Andhra—with ₹50 crore per district in total
Eight districts—four in Rayalaseema and four in North Andhra—with ₹50 crore per district per year
accepted.x: The package covered seven districts: four in Rayalaseema and three in North Andhra. It provided ₹50 crore per district per year and was based on the KBK/Bundelkhand model.
accepted.tq: Break the quantitative option into number, regional composition and annual amount.
accepted.sec: AP Reorganisation Act 2014 - backward districts package, special category status

accepted.s: The model associated with the backward districts package for Andhra Pradesh was:
accepted.x: The backward districts package was designed on the KBK/Bundelkhand model.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between similarly described regional-development models.
accepted.sec: AP Reorganisation Act 2014 - backward districts package, special category status

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Special Category Status debate concerning Andhra Pradesh:
1. The Prime Minister promised Special Category Status in the Rajya Sabha in February 2014.
2. The Fourteenth Finance Commission ended the general-versus-special distinction for devolution.
3. A special assistance measure was offered instead.
4. The demand has ceased to be a political issue.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1, 2 and 3 are correct. Statement 4 is false because the demand remains a political issue.
accepted.tq: Find the single extreme conclusion that reverses the continuing political relevance.
accepted.sec: AP Reorganisation Act 2014 - backward districts package, special category status

accepted.s: Which of the following regions has historically been more developed than North Andhra and Rayalaseema, particularly in the case of Krishna-Guntur?
accepted.x: Coastal Andhra, especially the Krishna-Guntur region, has historically been more developed than North Andhra and Rayalaseema.
accepted.tq: Identify the direction of the regional-development comparison.
accepted.sec: Regional disparity indicators - irrigation, per capita income, literacy

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the change in the approach to addressing regional disparities in Andhra Pradesh?
o: The BRGF continues as the sole state incentive mechanism.
Regional disparities are addressed only through Special Category Status.
The defunct BRGF has given way to state incentives such as the AP Industrial Policy 2023.
The AP Industrial Policy 2023 has been replaced by the defunct BRGF.
accepted.x: The defunct Backward Regions Grant Fund has given way to state incentives such as those under the AP Industrial Policy 2023.
accepted.tq: Use the status-word trap: identify the defunct mechanism and its successor approach.
accepted.sec: Regional disparity indicators - irrigation, per capita income, literacy

accepted.s:
Which of the following combinations is associated with the emergence of Rayalaseema as an industrial hub?
1. JSW steel plant in Kadapa
2. Kia plant
3. Royal Enfield facility in Tirupati
4. Renewable parks
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: JSW steel in Kadapa, the Kia plant, Royal Enfield in Tirupati and renewable parks are all associated with Rayalaseema’s emergence as an industrial hub.
accepted.tq: Use the all-inclusive option only after verifying every listed industrial example.

accepted.s: Which of the following is proposed in connection with the expansion of industrial and strategic activity in the Rayalaseema-related region?
o: A common capital at Hyderabad for ten years
A special committee on Telangana surpluses
accepted.x: A Space City near Sriharikota has been proposed, alongside defence units and renewable parks, in the broader regional-development context.

accepted.s: A proposal to establish two additional AIIMS—one in Rayalaseema and another in the north coastal districts—was intended primarily to address:
o: The devolution formula of the Finance Commission
accepted.x: The proposal for two additional AIIMS was aimed at reducing regional healthcare gaps in Rayalaseema and the north coastal districts.

accepted.s: With reference to regional disparity and special constitutional arrangements, which one of the following is correctly matched?
o: Kalyana Karnataka — Section 94 of the AP Reorganisation Act
North Andhra — Article 46(2)-(3) of the AP Reorganisation Act
accepted.x: Kalyana Karnataka has special status under Article 371J since 2013, although disparities continue. The other pairs wrongly combine unrelated constitutional or statutory provisions.
accepted.tq: Match the region with the correct constitutional provision, not a nearby AP provision.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which of the following statements best reflects the criticism regarding the Sri Bagh Pact and the Gentlemen’s Agreement?
o: They dealt exclusively with the location of the new capital after 2014.
They abolished all sub-regional differences through permanent constitutional guarantees.
They replaced the Fourteenth Finance Commission’s devolution formula.
They institutionalised sub-regional fault lines, and poor implementation contributed to later agitations.
accepted.x: The agreement-based safeguards of the Sri Bagh Pact of 1937 and the Gentlemen’s Agreement of 1956 are criticised for institutionalising sub-regional fault lines; poor implementation fed subsequent agitations.
accepted.tq: Choose the option that captures both the institutional effect and the implementation failure.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s:
Arrange the following in chronological order:
A. Gentlemen’s Agreement
B. Sri Bagh Pact
C. Special Category Status promise in the Rajya Sabha
D. Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act coming into effect
accepted.x: The Sri Bagh Pact dates to 1937, the Gentlemen’s Agreement to 1956, the Special Category Status promise to February 2014, and the Reorganisation Act took effect on 2 June 2014.
accepted.tq: Fix the first and last events, then place the two 2014 events in sequence.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: The Sri Bagh Pact is regarded as the first Coastal-Rayalaseema accord. Its agreement-based template was later reused in:
o: The special assistance measure after the Fourteenth Finance Commission
accepted.x: The Sri Bagh Pact was the first Coastal-Rayalaseema accord, and its ‘gentlemen’s agreement’ template was reused in 1956.
accepted.tq: Use the FIRST/LAST relationship to connect the original accord with its later template.
accepted.sec: Universal angles
